_comment: WORKFLOW-DEFINITION-DRIFT-1 (issue #1669). Canonical source of truth for live qnfo-audit fleet_tasks.definition values. The D1 table fleet_tasks_canonical is seeded from this file and a drift-gate fleet_task (fleet-tasks-drift-gate) files an agent_issue whenever the live definition differs from the canonical copy. Regenerate with scripts/export_fleet_tasks_canonical.py --write (never by hand).

{"model":"@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast","prompt":"You are solving ARC (Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus) tasks. For each of 5 tasks, infer the transformation rule from the example input-output pair, then apply it to the test input. Answer as a JSON object with keys t1..t5; each value is the output grid as a single string of integers in row-major order separated by spaces. No explanations.
t1 (fill entire grid with the single colored cell's color): example input '1 0 0 / 0 0 0 / 0 0 0' output '1 1 1 / 1 1 1 / 1 1 1'. test input '0 0 0 / 0 0 0 / 0 0 7'.
t2 (mirror the grid left-right): example input '1 0 0 / 2 0 0 / 3 0 0' output '0 0 1 / 0 0 2 / 0 0 3'. test input '7 0 0 / 8 0 0 / 9 0 0'.
t3 (replace every 2 with 3): example input '1 1 2 / 1 2 2 / 2 2 2' output '1 1 3 / 1 3 3 / 3 3 3'. test input '2 2 1 / 2 1 1 / 1 1 1'.
t4 (count colored cells, output an N by N grid filled with N): example input '0 1 0 / 0 1 0 / 0 0 0' output '2 2 / 2 2'. test input '1 0 0 / 0 1 0 / 0 0 1'.
t5 (rotate the grid 90 degrees clockwise): example input '1 2 3 / 4 5 6 / 7 8 9' output '7 4 1 / 8 5 2 / 9 6 3'. test input '1 0 0 / 0 0 0 / 0 0 0'.","max_tokens":400}

WHERE model_id IN (SELECT model_id FROM cf_model_evals WHERE verdict='reject' AND detail LIKE '%enum system not in user,assistant%' AND run_ts > datetime('now','-2 days'))"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE cf_model_catalog SET status='unavailable', notes='every probe errored (access gating or endpoint unavailable); not a quality signal' WHERE model_id IN (SELECT model_id FROM cf_model_evals WHERE verdict='reject' AND passed=0 AND detail NOT LIKE '%"err":null%' AND run_ts > datetime('now','-2 days'))"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO agent_issues (title, description, source, category, priority, status, created_at, updated_at)
            SELECT 'CF-MODEL-EVAL-1: cost-candidate '||c.model_id,
                   'Model '||c.model_id||' scored '||c.best_score||' on the chat battery (control '||COALESCE((SELECT best_score FROM cf_model_catalog WHERE model_id='@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3-flash'),0)||') at $'||COALESCE(c.price_in,0)||'/M input vs the control at $'||COALESCE((SELECT price_in FROM cf_model_catalog WHERE model_id='@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3-flash'),0)||'/M.               AND COALESCE(c.price_in,999) < COALESCE((SELECT price_in FROM cf_model_catalog WHERE model_id='@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3-flash'),0)"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO agent_issues (title, description, source, category, priority, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT 'CF-MODEL-EVAL-1: the model evaluation loop has not run for 48h', 'cf_model_eval_runs has no run newer than 48h. Auto-closed by CODE-LOOP-TERMINAL-RECONCILE-1.' FROM agent_issues a JOIN (SELECT id, substr(substr(title, instr(title,'CODE-LOOP-EXHAUSTED-1: ')+23), 1, instr(substr(title, instr(title,'CODE-LOOP-EXHAUSTED-1: ')+23),' ')-1) ct FROM agent_issues WHERE title LIKE '%CODE-LOOP-EXHAUSTED-1: ct_%') x ON x.id = a.id JOIN code_tasks t ON t.id = x.ct WHERE a.status='open' AND instr(substr(a.title, instr(a.title,'CODE-LOOP-EXHAUSTED-1: ')+23),' ') > 0 AND t.status='merged' ON CONFLICT(issue_id) DO UPDATE SET triage_state='resolved', close_evidence=excluded.close_evidence"}]}

issue-sla-invariant-guard.definition: {"steps":[{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","name":"repair-missing-rows","sql":"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO issue_triage (issue_id, rc, triage_state, owner, sla_due_at, triaged_at) SELECT a.id, 'AUTOTRIAGE-3', 'triaged', COALESCE((SELECT t.owner FROM analytics_metric_triggers t WHERE a.title LIKE 'METRIC-TRIGGER-%' AND t.id = CAST(substr(a.title, 16) AS INTEGER) AND t.owner IN (SELECT service FROM service_registry)), 'qnfo-ops'), datetime('now', '+120 minutes'), datetime('now') FROM agent_issues a WHERE a.status = 'open' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_triage t2 WHERE t2.issue_id = a.id)"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","name":"repair-null-deadlines","sql":"UPDATE issue_triage SET sla_due_at = datetime('now', '+120 minutes') WHERE (sla_due_at IS NULL OR trim(sla_due_at) = '') AND issue_id IN (SELECT id FROM agent_issues WHERE status = 'open')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","name":"record-window-violation","sql":"INSERT INTO issue_ledger (fingerprint, source, level, category, title, status, first_seen, last_seen, occurrences, last_detail, updated_at) SELECT 'issue-sla-window-violation', 'issue-sla-invariant-guard', 'high', 'reliability', 'ISSUE-SLA-INVARIANT-1: ' || (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_issues a JOIN issue_triage t ON t.issue_id = a.id WHERE a.created_at >= (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM ops_config WHERE key = 'issue_sla_window_baseline_ms') AND a.created_at <= CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 AND a.status = 'open' AND t.sla_due_at <= datetime(a.created_at/1000, 'unixepoch')) || ' open issue(s) created after the baseline have a deadline at or before their own created_at, so the 120-minute window is not being applied', 'open', datetime('now'), datetime('now'), 1, 'The single writer of an issue SLA deadline is the agent_issues_autotriage2_ins trigger. This row lives in issue_ledger because agent_issues refuses every INSERT ... SELECT form at compile time (D1 7500), which is why the earlier version of this guard flapped. Definition of done: sqlite_master for agent_issues_autotriage2_ins contains +120 minutes and this row is resolved. Second path: this guard repairs a missing or NULL deadline with the same 120-minute rule every 10 minutes, so issues keep a real SLA while the trigger is broken.', datetime('now') FROM (SELECT 1) WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_issues a JOIN issue_triage t ON t.issue_id = a.id WHERE a.created_at >= (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM ops_config WHERE key = 'issue_sla_window_baseline_ms') AND a.created_at <= CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 AND a.status = 'open' AND t.sla_due_at <= datetime(a.created_at/1000, 'unixepoch')) > 0 ON CONFLICT(fingerprint) DO UPDATE SET status = 'open', title = excluded.title, last_seen = datetime('now'), occurrences = occurrences + 1, last_detail = excluded.last_detail, updated_at = datetime('now')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","name":"clear-window-violation","sql":"UPDATE issue_ledger SET status = 'resolved', resolved_at = datetime('now'), resolution_note = 'auto: every open issue created after the baseline carries a 120-minute SLA window again', updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE fingerprint = 'issue-sla-window-violation' AND status = 'open' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_issues a JOIN issue_triage t ON t.issue_id = a.id WHERE a.created_at >= (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM ops_config WHERE key = 'issue_sla_window_baseline_ms') AND a.created_at <= CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 AND a.status = 'open' AND t.sla_due_at <= datetime(a.created_at/1000, 'unixepoch')) = 0"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","name":"ledger","sql":"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO cloud_ops_events (id, ts, kind, text, meta, job, status) SELECT 'issue-sla-invariant-guard-' || strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S','now'), datetime('now'), 'issue-sla-invariant-guard', 'ISSUE-SLA-INVARIANT-GUARD-1: ' || (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_issues a WHERE a.status = 'open' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_triage t WHERE t.issue_id = a.id)) || ' open issues without a triage row | ' || (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_issues a JOIN issue_triage t ON t.issue_id = a.id WHERE a.status = 'open' AND (t.sla_due_at IS NULL OR trim(t.sla_due_at) = '')) || ' without a deadline | ' || (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_issues a JOIN issue_triage t ON t.issue_id = a.id WHERE a.created_at >= (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM ops_config WHERE key = 'issue_sla_window_baseline_ms') AND a.created_at <= CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 AND a.status = 'open' AND t.sla_due_at <= datetime(a.created_at/1000, 'unixepoch')) || ' post-baseline rows with no window' || ' | trigger liveness-keeper.definition:
{"steps":[{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS liveness_gaps (day TEXT NOT NULL, cron_name TEXT NOT NULL, overdue_min INTEGER, caught_up INTEGER DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')), PRIMARY KEY (day, cron_name))"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO liveness_gaps (day, cron_name, overdue_min)
    SELECT date('now'), name, CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(next_fire)) * 1440 AS INTEGER)
    FROM fleet_crons
    WHERE enabled = 1 AND next_fire IS NOT NULL AND julianday(next_fire) < julianday('now', '-15 minutes')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE fleet_crons SET next_fire = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z','now'), updated_at = datetime('now')
    WHERE enabled = 1 AND next_fire IS NOT NULL AND julianday(next_fire) < julianday('now', '-15 minutes')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE liveness_gaps SET caught_up = 1 WHERE day = date('now')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO cloud_ops_events (id, ts, kind, text, meta, job, status)
    SELECT 'liveness-keeper-'||strftime('%Y%m%d%H','now'), datetime('now'), 'liveness-keeper',
      'LIVENESS-KEEPER-1: '||COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM liveness_gaps WHERE day=date('now')),0)||' overdue crons caught up; last tick '||

{"steps":[{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","name":"close-unobserved","sql":"UPDATE portfolio_gaps SET status='closed', resolved_at=COALESCE(resolved_at, datetime('now'))

WHERE status='open' AND kind='upgrade-compat'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cloud_ops_events e
    WHERE e.kind='portfolio-upgrade' AND e.text LIKE 'UPG-'||portfolio_gaps.entity||' %verified%'
      AND e.ts > COALESCE(portfolio_gaps.first_seen, portfolio_gaps.day))"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","name":"file-actionable-gaps","sql":"INSERT INTO agent_issues (title, description, source, category, priority, status, created_at, updated_at)
SELECT 'PORTFOLIO-GAP '||g.kind||' '||g.entity,
  'Filed by the portfolio autopilot from an open portfolio gap. '||COALESCE(g.detail,'')||' (entity '||g.entity||', first seen '||COALESCE(g.first_seen,'?')||').'||
  ' Remediation: '||CASE g.kind
    WHEN 'upgrade-compat' THEN 'advance the worker compat_date and re-verify the deploy.'
    WHEN 'deploy-unrecorded' THEN 'record the live deployment in project_ledger, or redeploy through the canonical path.'
    WHEN 'project-stale-deploy' THEN 'redeploy the project, or record that it is intentionally frozen.'
    ELSE 'assign an owner_service from program_owner_map.' END,
  'portfolio-autopilot', 'portfolio',
  CASE WHEN g.kind IN ('upgrade-compat','project-stale-deploy','deploy-unrecorded') THEN 'high' ELSE 'medium' END,

  AND NOT (g.kind='upgrade-compat' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cloud_ops_events e

    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues a2 WHERE a2.title='PORTFOLIO-GAP '||portfolio_gaps.kind||' '||portfolio_gaps.entity AND a2.status NOT IN ('closed','resolved','done'))

GROUP BY 1"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","name":"triage-umbrella","sql":"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO issue_triage (issue_id, rc, triage_state, owner, sla_due_at, triaged_at)

  description=description||char(10)||'RED-GATE-1: escalated to critical - open red with no update for 48h and no code task referencing it.'
WHERE rowid IN (
  SELECT a.rowid FROM agent_issues a
  WHERE a.status='open' AND a.priority IN ('critical','high')
    AND a.updated_at < CAST(strftime('%s','now','-48 hours') AS INTEGER)*1000
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code_tasks c WHERE c.status NOT IN ('merged','closed','failed','superseded')
      AND (c.goal LIKE '%'||a.id||'%' OR COALESCE(c.ctx,'') LIKE '%'||a.id||'%'))
  ORDER BY a.priority, a.updated_at LIMIT 20)"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","name":"compute-idle","sql":"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO red_gate_state (k, v, ts)
SELECT 'idle',
  CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT red_total FROM red_snapshots ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1),0) > 0
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code_tasks WHERE status='queued')
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v_recent_open_issues)
       THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  datetime('now')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","name":"keep-going-when-idle-and-red","sql":"INSERT INTO agent_issues (title, description, source, category, priority, status, created_at, updated_at)

  'red_total='||COALESCE((SELECT red_total FROM red_snapshots ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1),0)||' but nothing is moving: no code task queued and no open issue updated in 2h. '||
  'The directive is that the fleet never stops with outstanding reds; this issue exists so that idleness is itself a red item.',
  'red-gate', 'automation', 'critical', 'open',
  CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER), CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)
FROM red_gate_state s
